questions.question_text: At a roundabout, who should you give priority to?
questions.explanation: You must yield to traffic approaching from the right at a roundabout.

questions.question_text: At a roundabout, which traffic should you normally give priority to?
options: Traffic that is already on the roundabout
Traffic that has its indicators on
questions.explanation: You must give way to traffic coming from your right unless signs or road markings state otherwise.

questions.question_text: At a mini-roundabout, who has priority?
questions.explanation: You should always give way to traffic approaching from the right at roundabouts.

questions.question_text: Who has priority at a mini-roundabout?
questions.explanation: At a mini-roundabout, you must give priority to traffic approaching from your right, just like a standard roundabout.

questions.question_text: Who has the right of way at a mini-roundabout?
options: The driver who reaches it first
questions.explanation: Always give way to traffic coming from your right at roundabouts, unless signs or markings state otherwise.

questions.question_text: When approaching a zebra crossing, what must you do?
options: Speed up to clear the crossing
Be prepared to stop if pedestrians are waiting
Sound your horn to warn pedestrians
Only stop if someone is actually on the crossing
questions.explanation: You must be ready to stop to allow pedestrians to cross at a zebra crossing.
